The gothic drama Sinners leads the field with a record 16 nominations, while One Battle After Another also enters the night as a major contender with multiple nominations, including Best Picture, acting, and directing categories.Several star-studded acting races are also expected to draw attention. The Best Actor category features nominees including Michael B. Jordan (Sinners), Leonardo DiCaprio (One Battle After Another), Timothée Chalamet (Marty Supreme), Ethan Hawke (Blue Moon), and Wagner Moura (The Secret Agent).
